    (L₂ : Ledger A) (τe : Trace A)
    (hs₂ : sender ∈ L₂.live) (he₂ : escrow ∈ L₂.live) (hc₂ : coinbase ∈ L₂.live)

    (hacce : L₂.supply + burned τe
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P) he₀).supply
        + minted τe)

      τ = τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]
      ∧ L'.supply + burned τ = L₀.supply + minted τ
      ∧ burned τ = burned τe + B
      ∧ minted τ = minted τe
      ∧ SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τ
      ∧ L'.supply ≤ L₀.supply
      ∧ L'.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow
      ∧ L'.live = L₂.live :=

  let L₃ := (L₂.setBal escrow (L₂.bal escrow - R) he₂).setBal sender
    ((L₂.setBal escrow (L₂.bal escrow - R) he₂).bal sender + R) hs₂
  let L₄ := (L₃.setBal escrow (L₃.bal escrow - T) he₂).setBal coinbase
    ((L₃.setBal escrow (L₃.bal escrow - T) he₂).bal coinbase + T) hc₂
  let L₅ := L₄.setBal escrow (L₄.bal escrow - B) he₂
  let hR₂ : R ≤ L₂.bal escrow :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun n => R ≤ n)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => e₀ + n) hsplit) hesc.symm)
      (escrow_guard e₀ R (T + B))
  let e₃ : L₃.bal escrow = e₀ + (T + B) :=
    Eq.trans (Ledger.xfer_bal_src L₂ escrow sender R he₂ hs₂ hse)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n - R) hesc)
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => (e₀ + n) - R) hsplit.symm)
          (escrow_after e₀ R (T + B))))
  let hT₃ : T ≤ L₃.bal escrow :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun n => T ≤ n) e₃.symm (escrow_guard e₀ T B)
  let e₄ : L₄.bal escrow = e₀ + B :=
    Eq.trans (Ledger.xfer_bal_src L₃ escrow coinbase T he₂ hc₂ hec)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n - T) e₃) (escrow_after e₀ T B))
  let hB₄ : B ≤ L₄.bal escrow :=
    Eq.subst (motive := fun n => B ≤ n) e₄.symm (escrow_guard e₀ B 0)
  let e₅ : L₅.bal escrow = e₀ :=
    Eq.trans (Ledger.setBal_bal_self L₄ escrow (L₄.bal escrow - B) he₂)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n - B) e₄) (escrow_after e₀ B 0))
  let c₅ :=
    Ledger.supply_acc_trans
      (Ledger.supply_acc_trans
        (Ledger.supply_acc_trans
          (Ledger.supply_acc_trans
            (Ledger.acc_xfer L₀ sender escrow P hs₀ he₀ hP) hacce)
          (Ledger.acc_xfer L₂ escrow sender R he₂ hs₂ hR₂))
        (Ledger.acc_xfer L₃ escrow coinbase T he₂ hc₂ hT₃))
      (Ledger.acc_burn L₄ escrow B he₂ hB₄)

    Eq.trans (burned_append τe [Ev.burn escrow B])
      (congrArg (fun n => n + B) (Nat.zero_add (burned τe)).symm)

    Eq.trans (minted_append τe [Ev.burn escrow B])
      (Nat.zero_add (minted τe)).symm

      = L₀.supply + minted (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) :=
    Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => L₅.supply + n) hbτ)
      (Eq.trans c₅ (congrArg (fun n => L₀.supply + n) hmτ.symm))
  let hconf : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) :=
    SiteConfined.append hconfe (SiteConfined.burn ([] : List A) escrow B)
  ⟨L₅, τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B],
   rfl, hacc,
   Eq.trans hbτ (congrArg (fun n => n + B) (Nat.zero_add (burned τe))),
   Eq.trans hmτ (Nat.zero_add (minted τe)),
